name: MIMIC-IV-Echo: Echocardiogram Matched Subset
description: MIMIC-IV-Echo is a matched multimodal cardiac imaging subset of the MIMIC-IV database, released on PhysioNet by the MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology. The database links comprehensive transthoracic and transesophageal echocardiography reports and associated DICOM video studies to patient hospitalizations in MIMIC-IV between 2008 and 2019. It captures detailed structural and hemodynamic cardiac assessments, including left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), chamber dimensions, wall motion abnormalities, valvular regurgitation and stenosis gradings, and pulmonary artery pressures, providing a rich foundation for multimodal deep learning bridging cardiac ultrasound with electronic health records.
